text:
**Starts after:** P2-T13, P3-T1 (P3:slip-qr), P3-T14 (P3:ai-area), P4-T6 (P4:slips-route), P4-T7 (P4:slip-drafts), P4-T14 (P4:slip-client), P4-T21 (P4:inbox), P6A-T4, P6A-T6a

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/app/src/wallet/outside/appSharedSlipDeps.ts`, `SharedSlipCard.tsx`, `SharedSlipScreen.tsx`, `SharesWaitingTray.tsx`; `apps/app/app/spend/shared.tsx`
- Modify: `OutsideBridge.tsx` (offers `SharesWaitingTray`), `outsideCopy.draft.ts`, `outsideSections.tsx` (`bw-ox-shared-read`, `bw-ox-shared-private`, `bw-ox-shared-not-slip`, `bw-ox-shared-waiting`, `bw-ox-shares-tray`)
- Test: `apps/app/src/wallet/outside/SharedSlip.render.test.tsx`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: P6A-T6a; `getAppQrDecoder`, `installQrDecoder`, `fakeQrDecoder` (P3-T1, P3:slip-qr); P4-T14 (P4:slip-client)'s `useSlipDeps()`, `useSlips()`, `sendOneSlip`, `SlipsProvider` and `fakeSlipEngine`, and `fakeSlipResources` (P4-T12); `SLIP_REVIEW_HREF` (P4-T21, P4:inbox); `AiConsentTray` (`{ visible, onClose, onAgreed }`, P3-T14 (P3:ai-area)); base `useAiCompanion`, `todayInBangkok`, `getCredentialProvider`; `Tray`, `PrimaryButton`, `TextLink` (P2-T13); `WalletAmount`, `HIDDEN_AMOUNT`, `usePrivateMode` (P2-T10); `useDraftCopy`, `COMMON_COPY` (P2-T3) or `useWalletCopy` (P2-T38); `useAddTray` (P2-T16).
- Produces:
  ```ts
  export function useSharedSlipDeps(): SharedSlipDeps;
  export function SharedSlipCard(props: { result: SharedSlipResult; hidden: boolean; onInbox(): void; onLogIt(): void; onDone(): void }): JSX.Element;
  export function SharedSlipScreen(): JSX.Element;
  export function SharesWaitingTray(props: { count: number; onRead(): void; onLater(): void }): JSX.Element;
  ```
- `useSharedSlipDeps` (A1, A32): `deps` is P4-T14's `useSlipDeps()`, the open diary's slip deps (P3's decoder, P4's shrinker, `getSharedSlipResources()` and the salted hasher), so P6A wires none of P4's parts. `check` is `checkSharedSlip(getAppQrDecoder(), uri)`; `send` is `sendOneSlip(deps, { uri, origin: 'share' })`, so P4 posts one `live` batch of one with `last: false`, `album: null` and A1's `origin: 'share'`, and P6A never names a record source; `view` is `sharedDraftView` over `deps.resources.accounts()` (a failure gives none) and the diary's wallets and categories; `signedIn` is true while the open diary names an account and `deps` is not null (so neither `send` nor `view` runs without them); `consentRefused` is `useAiCompanion().preferences?.companion === false` (P4-T18's rule); `slipsOn` is `useSlips() !== null`: P4's engine exists only while `useSlipsArea()` is on (A10, P6B-T15's rollout inside it).
- `/spend/shared` (`<Redirect href="/spend" />` with the area off; P4's one `SlipsProvider` in `WalletShell` already wraps it): once the diary is ready, takes the incoming shares, enqueues each under this account's marker (`accountMarker(view.accountId, appDigest)`), calls `clear()`, drains, and shows one `SharedSlipCard` per result, newest first, with บันกำลังอ่านสลิป (draft) until then; once the session settles signed out first (`hydrating` ending in `signed_out`, or a sign-out), takes and clears them, keeping nothing. `needs_consent` opens `AiConsentTray` first; `onAgreed` drains again.

Each other result shows one draft line that says the slip or records are safe and offers a way on (§5.2's system states): duplicate `outside.known` Jotbun เคยอ่านสลิปนี้แล้ว (dismissed and expired slips too, C11); unreadable บันอ่านสลิปนี้ไม่ได้ จดเองได้เลย and too_large `outside.tooLarge` รูปนี้ใหญ่เกินกว่าบันจะอ่านได้ จดเองได้เลย, each with a `PrimaryButton` จดเอง opening the add tray; not_slip รูปนี้ไม่ใช่สลิปธนาคาร Jotbun ไม่ได้ส่งรูปนี้ไปไหน; cannot_check `outside.cannotCheck` เครื่องนี้ยังตรวจสลิปไม่ได้ Jotbun ไม่ได้ส่งรูปนี้ไปไหน; over_quota วันนี้บันอ่านสลิปครบแล้ว สลิปนี้รออ่านพรุ่งนี้ในเครื่อง; paused บันพักอยู่ สลิปนี้รออ่านในเครื่อง; offline ยังไม่มีสัญญาณ สลิปนี้รออ่านในเครื่อง; update_required `outside.needsUpdate` อัปเดต Jotbun ก่อน สลิปนี้รออ่านในเครื่อง; failed `outside.failed` ส่งไม่สำเร็จ สลิปยังอยู่ในเครื่อง (§5.1); signed_out `outside.signIn` เข้าสู่ระบบ Jotbun ก่อน แล้วแชร์สลิปอีกครั้ง. title: The native base: ids, the app group, keychain groups, privacy manifests and a config check in CI
heading: Task P6A-T7: The native base: ids, the app group, keychain groups, privacy manifests and a config check in CI
starts_after_text: 1C-T7, P6A-T1. Its final values wait on owner Q6 (D33): it is built and checked with the temporary ids, and nothing native is built or signed until D33.
text:
**Starts after:** 1C-T7, P6A-T1. Its final values wait on owner Q6 (D33): it is built and checked with the temporary ids, and nothing native is built or signed until D33.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/app/outsideConfig.js` (CommonJS: Node built-ins and `expo/config-plugins`), `apps/app/scripts/check-native-config.mjs`
- Modify: 1C-T7's `apps/app/app.config.js` (its transform becomes the named `withNativeSignIn(config)`, unchanged, and the file exports `({ config }) => withOutside(withNativeSignIn(config), process.env)`); `apps/app/package.json` (script `"check:native": "node scripts/check-native-config.mjs"`); `apps/app/.gitignore` (`/ios`, `/android`: introspection and prebuild write there); `.github/workflows/backend.yml` (one gate-job step after `npm run typecheck:app`: `npm run check:native -w gogospend-app`)
- Test: `check-native-config.mjs` runs `npx expo config --type introspect --json` with no ids set, with `JOTBUN_IOS_BUNDLE_ID=th.co.jotbun.check JOTBUN_ANDROID_PACKAGE=th.co.jotbun_check JOTBUN_APPLE_TEAM_ID=ABCDE12345`, and with `JOTBUN_IOS_BUNDLE_ID='bad id'`, and exits non-zero naming the first mismatch; `apps/app/src/wallet/outside/outsideConfig.test.ts` (Node, loading `outsideConfig.js` through `createRequire`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Expo's dynamic config (`app.config.js` receives `app.json` as `({ config })`); `npx expo config --type introspect --json` (the evaluated entitlements and `Info.plist` under `_internal.modResults.ios`; only introspective mods run); @expo/config-plugins 58.0.9's `withFinalizedMod` (an iOS mod that runs after every other mod) and `withXcodeProject`; 1C-T7's transform; P6A-T1's id patterns.
- Produces:
  ```js
  // outsideConfig.js
  /** @typedef {{ type: string; reasons: string[] }} PrivacyEntry */
  /** @param {import('expo/config').ExpoConfig} config @param {Record<string, string | undefined>} env @returns {import('expo/config').ExpoConfig} */
  function withOutside(config, env) {}
  function withExtensionFiles(config, target) {}   // target: { name: string; keychainGroups?: string[]; privacy: PrivacyEntry[] }
  function privacyManifestXml(entries) {}   // PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy: no tracking, no tracking domains, no collected data, exactly these API entries
  function extensionEntitlements(existing, keychainGroups) {}   // the package's entitlements plus keychain-access-groups
  const OUTSIDE_PLUGINS = [];   // P6A-T8 to P6A-T12 append, each after its owner answer
  const OUTSIDE_PRIVACY = [];   // the app target's entries; P6A-T8, T10, T11 and T12 append theirs
  module.exports = { withOutside, withExtensionFiles, privacyManifestXml, extensionEntitlements, OUTSIDE_PLUGINS, OUTSIDE_PRIVACY, IOS_BUNDLE_ID_PATTERN, ANDROID_PACKAGE_PATTERN };
  ```
- `withOutside` (default pending owner Q6): `ios.bundleIdentifier` is `JOTBUN_IOS_BUNDLE_ID` or `co.gogocash.jotbun.localcheck`; `android.package` is `JOTBUN_ANDROID_PACKAGE` or `app.json`'s; a value failing its pattern throws, naming the variable. `ios.entitlements` gains `com.apple.security.application-groups: ['group.<bundle>']` and `keychain-access-groups: ['$(AppIdentifierPrefix)<bundle>', '$(AppIdentifierPrefix)<bundle>.shared']`, the app's own group first so an item saved without a group (the diary key, P2's stores) never lands in the shared one. `ios.privacyManifests.NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes` gains `OUTSIDE_PRIVACY`, merged by type. `extra.outside` is `{ iosBundleId, androidPackage, appGroup: 'group.<bundle>', keychainGroup: '<team id>.<bundle>.shared' or null without JOTBUN_APPLE_TEAM_ID, scheme }`. `plugins` is the incoming config's then `OUTSIDE_PLUGINS`. Nothing else changes; no `aps-environment` (push is P4's).
- `withExtensionFiles` adds a `withFinalizedMod` iOS mod that writes `ios/<name>/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy` and, with `keychainGroups`, rewrites `ios/<name>/<name>.entitlements` through `extensionEntitlements` after the package's own writer, plus a `withXcodeProject` mod adding the manifest to that target's resources. Introspection never runs them, so their functions are tested in Node. P6A-T8, T10 and T11 name their target's categories, Apple's reasons confirmed at install.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the check script and the failing tests.** The script checks, in the first two cases: the bundle id, the package, the app group entitlement, the keychain groups in order, `extra.outside` field by field, the `gogospend` scheme in `CFBundleURLTypes`, and `ios.usesAppleSignIn` true with `expo-apple-authentication` in `plugins` (1C-T7's sign-in survives); in the second also `keychainGroup` `ABCDE12345.th.co.jotbun.check.shared` and the package `th.co.jotbun_check`; the third must exit non-zero naming `JOTBUN_IOS_BUNDLE_ID`. `outsideConfig.test.ts`: `the config's id patterns are P6A-T1's` (equal regex sources); `a privacy manifest declares exactly its entries and no tracking`; `an extension's entitlements gain the shared keychain group and keep the app group`.
- [ ] **Step 2: Run them and see them fail.** `npm run check:native -w gogospend-app` (FAIL, no bundle identifier); unit `outsideConfig.test.ts`.
- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** the config file, the composition, the script entry, the ignore lines and the CI step.
- [ ] **Step 4: Run them and see them pass,** then `npm run test:ops` (its `backend-workflow.test.mjs` reads the edited workflow) and the app gate (`export:web` reads the same config).
- [ ] **Step 5: Mutation check.** Export `withOutside(config, process.env)` alone, over `app.json`: the sign-in check fails. Put the shared keychain group first: the order check fails. Drop `extra.outside`: its check fails. Check the package with the iOS pattern: the `th.co.jotbun_check` case fails.
- [ ] **Step 6: Receipt, commit.** SKIPPED until D33: the final ids, `npx expo prebuild` on a Mac, signing. `git commit -m "Add the native base over 1C's sign-in config: ids from the environment, the app group and keychain groups, privacy manifests and an introspected config check in CI"`

- Produces:
  ```ts
  export type WidgetEntryProps = { entry: WidgetEntry; links: WidgetLinks; labels: WidgetLabels };   // iOS, one per timeline entry
  export type AndroidWidgetProps = { entries: readonly WidgetEntry[]; links: WidgetLinks; labels: WidgetLabels };   // the layout picks the entry current when it is drawn
  export type TimelineWidget = { updateTimeline(entries: { date: Date; props: WidgetEntryProps }[]): void; updateSnapshot(props: WidgetEntryProps | AndroidWidgetProps): void };
  export type InstalledWidgetsModule = { families(): Promise<readonly string[]> };   // WidgetKit family names, or 'android' per placed widget
  export function sizesOf(families: readonly string[]): WidgetSize[];   // systemSmall small, systemMedium medium, systemLarge large, accessory* lock_screen, android small; others dropped
  export function createExpoWidgetPort(widgets: { today: TimelineWidget; log: TimelineWidget }, platform: 'ios' | 'android', installed?: () => Promise<InstalledWidgetsModule | null>): WidgetPort;
  ```
- The plugin entry: `["expo-widgets", { "groupIdentifier": "group.<bundle>", "enableAndroid": true, "widgets": [{ "name": "JotbunToday", "displayName": "Jotbun วันนี้", "description": "ยอดที่ใช้วันนี้ จำนวนรายการ และที่เหลือต่อวัน", "ios": { "supportedFamilies": ["systemSmall", "systemMedium", "accessoryInline", "accessoryCircular", "accessoryRectangular"] }, "android": { "minWidth": 110, "minHeight": 110, "targetCellWidth": 2, "targetCellHeight": 2, "resizeMode": "none" } }, { "name": "JotbunLog", "displayName": "จดรายจ่าย", "description": "แตะเพื่อจดรายจ่าย", "ios": { "supportedFamilies": ["accessoryCircular"] }, "android": null }] }]` (one string each, so Thai first; the lines are E2 drafts).

Taps open `links.today`; `JotbunLog` draws `labels.log` with a plus and opens `links.record`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (expo-quick-actions 6.0.2's README and types): `setItems(actions)` with `{ id, title, subtitle?, icon?, params? }` (an empty list clears; `subtitle` iOS only; `symbol:` icons on iOS); `maxCount` (4 on iOS); `initial`, the launch action, set for the life of the process; `useQuickActionRouting(callback?)` from `expo-quick-actions/router` (`build/router.js`: on every mount it routes `initial`, then each listener event, to `params.href` in a `setTimeout`, unless `callback`'s answer is truthy, a promise included); the optional plugin's `androidIcons`.
- Produces:
  ```ts
  export type QuickActionsModule = { setItems(actions: readonly { id: string; title: string; subtitle?: string | null; icon?: string | null; params?: { href: string } }[]): Promise<void>; maxCount?: number };
  export function createExpoQuickActions(load: () => Promise<QuickActionsModule>, platform: 'ios' | 'android'): QuickActionsPort;
  export const QUICK_ICONS: Readonly<Record<QuickItem['id'], string>>;   // 'symbol:plus.circle', 'symbol:qrcode.viewfinder', 'symbol:calendar', 'symbol:bubble.left'
  export function QuickActionRouting(): null;
  ```
- `set(items)` sends `items.slice(0, maxCount ?? 4)` as `{ id, title, subtitle, icon: platform === 'ios' ? QUICK_ICONS[id] : id, params: { href } }`; a throw is swallowed. **Interfaces:**

- Produces:
  ```ts
  export function sharedKeychainOptions(ids: OutsideIds, platform: 'ios' | 'android' | 'web'): { accessGroup?: string };   // iOS with a keychain group only
  export function extensionAccount(token: string | null, file: AccountFile | null, digest: Digest): Promise<string | null>;   // the token's sub when accountMarker(sub) is the file's marker, else null
  export function extensionSharedSlipDeps(): Promise<SharedSlipDeps & { marker: string | null; hidden: boolean }>;
  export type ShareExtensionApi = { close(): void; openHostApp(path: string): void; clearShared(): Promise<void> };   // clearShared: the package's clearAppGroupContainer(), which empties only its own sharedData folder

  ```
- Keychain sharing (default pending owner Q7): Better Auth's session items live in `<team id>.<bundle>.shared`, and so does the extension's own copy of the slip salt (`secureSaltStore({ accessGroup })`, the option P4-T12 keeps for this extension): the account's one salt, fetched once by the extension, so its hashes match the app's. The app's salt (P4-T14's store), the diary key and every other item stay in the app's own group (P6A-T7's order). Earlier items stay put: nothing is live (§1), so a development build signs in once more.
- `extensionSharedSlipDeps` reads the account file, gets a token from 1C-T5's port over the shared items, takes the account from `extensionAccount` before anything reads the salt (none, or another account's token: `signedIn` false), reads AI preferences once (`consentRefused` only when they say `companion: false`; a failed read is no refusal), binds `check` as `useSharedSlipDeps` does, and `send` as `sendOneSlip` (`origin: 'share'`) over its own parts: `getAppQrDecoder()`, `pickerShrink()`, `today: () => todayInBangkok()`, `locale` the file's language, `createSlipResources` over a transport whose `analyticsOff` is always true, and `createSlipHasher` with that account id, those resources, `secureSaltStore({ accessGroup })` and `expoSha256()`. `slipsOn` is `slipsAreaOn()`, which sees neither P4's kept release nor P6B-T15's rollout: before the server releases slip import a share is sent once, meets the 404 and waits `paused`, and the app then holds it unsent. `view` names no wallet or category (no diary there; an E2 deviation). An image's media type comes from its file name; another type (HEIC) is `unreadable`, nothing sent.
- The sheet (ox-share-extension under B19) runs `readSharedSlip` on the one image and shows `SharedSlipCard` under `outside.shareTitle`; it never saves a record or sends a transaction command. `outside.done` closes; `outside.openInbox` calls `openHostApp` with P4-T21 (P4:inbox)'s route; จดเอง (`onLogIt`) calls `openHostApp` with `outside/record`. A waiting result is enqueued under the marker (`over_quota` with `notBefore: nextBangkokMidnight(nowMs)`) and says `outside.readsWhenOpen` unless its card line names a time, as `over_quota`'s does; `needs_consent` adds a `PrimaryButton` `outside.openJotbun` opening `spend/shared`, where consent comes first; `signed_out` keeps nothing; a full queue says `outside.full`. Every way out calls `clearShared()` before `close()` or `openHostApp`, so a waiting slip lives only in P6A-T6a's queue. The root wraps the card in `LanguageProvider` (its `device` the file's language) and `ThemeProvider`; the file's `hidden` masks the amount through the card's prop; text uses the system font, an E2 deviation.
- Copy (drafts): `outside.readsWhenOpen` บันจะอ่านสลิปนี้เมื่อเปิด Jotbun; `outside.needsBun` เปิดให้บันช่วยอ่านก่อน; `outside.openJotbun` เปิด Jotbun.

Record each. If any of (1) to (5) fails, stop: B19's fallback applies and P6A-T11 turns on expo-sharing's iOS extension. Until D33 exists this spike, and so this task, is SKIPPED.

  ```ts
  export type RestoreProgress = { fetched: number; total: number | null }   // sync/types.ts; fetched: entities downloaded so far
  ```

- Rules: progress is reported only during a restore: a snapshot resync (after each chunk `fetched` grows by its entities, `total` is `entity_count ?? null`, `fetched` never above `total`; the base `resync` swaps every chunk in at the end, so the count is what has arrived, not yet shown) or a pull from no cursor whose first page has changes or `has_more` (after each page `fetched` grows by its changes, `total` null); `null` once the run ends, whatever its outcome. title: Surveys, choice-only and after yes (B24)
heading: Task P6B-T13: Surveys, choice-only and after yes (B24)
text:
**Starts after:** P6B-T6, P2-T3, P2-T4, P2-T16, P2-T18, P2-T30, 1D-T6

**Files:**
- Create: `src/analytics/surveys.ts` (pure), `anonymousCapture.ts`; `src/wallet/surveys/surveyTriggers.ts` (pure), `SurveyTray.tsx`, `SurveyHost.tsx`, `useLeavingSurvey.tsx`, `copy.draft.ts`
- Modify: 1D's `gate.ts`, `controller.ts`, `bus.ts`, `appAnalytics.ts` (passes the ids), `testing/recordAnalytics.ts`; `src/config/env.ts` (`posthogSurveys` from `EXPO_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_SURVEYS`); P2-T18's `WalletShell.tsx` (`extras` on: one `<SurveyHost />`); `app/settings/delete.tsx` (`leaving={useLeavingSurvey()}`)
- Test: `src/analytics/surveys.test.ts`, `gate.test.ts`, `controller.test.ts`, `neverSent.test.ts`, `src/wallet/surveys/surveyTriggers.test.ts` (Node), `Survey.render.test.tsx`; 1D-T1's `after yes, allow-listed events…` case changes one expectation, as survey events follow the survey rule

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `GatePolicy`, `OutgoingEvent`, `PostHogLike`, `Analytics`, `getAnalytics`, `trackClientEvent`, `recordAnalytics` (1D-T1); `posthogHost`, `posthogKey` (1D-T6); `streakCount` (P2-T4); `useAddTray` (P2-T16); `walletAccountStore` (P2-T3); `Tray` (P2-T13); `DeleteScreen`'s `leaving` (P6B-T6); `randomUUID` (expo-crypto 58.0.6).
- Produces:
  ```ts
  export type SurveyKey = 'pmf' | 'slip_accuracy' | 'leaving' | 'ask_bun'
  export const SURVEYS: Readonly<Record<SurveyKey, { readonly question: string; readonly choices: readonly string[]; readonly active: boolean }>>   // English question; ask_bun inactive (X4), so the owner creates three single-choice API surveys
  export type SurveyIds = Readonly<Partial<Record<SurveyKey, { survey: string; question: string }>>>   // PostHog UUIDs
  export function parseSurveyIds(raw: string | undefined): SurveyIds   // bad JSON, unknown keys and non-UUID ids dropped
  export type SurveyEventName = 'survey shown' | 'survey sent' | 'survey dismissed'
  export type SurveyProps = { $survey_id: string; $survey_questions?: readonly { id: string; question: string }[] } & { [response: `$survey_response_${string}`]: string }
  export function surveyProps(key: SurveyKey, ids: SurveyIds, event: SurveyEventName, choice?: string): SurveyProps | null   // null without ids or with a choice not listed
  export function allowSurveyEvent<E extends OutgoingEvent>(event: E, ids: SurveyIds): E | null   // the gate's rule; GatePolicy gains surveys?: SurveyIds
  survey(name: SurveyEventName, properties: SurveyProps): void   // on Analytics: captured only in yes, never held; PostHogLike.capture takes CleanProps | SurveyProps
  export function subscribeAppEvents(listener: (name: AppEventName) => void): () => void   // bus.ts: after cleanEvent, the name only
  export function sendAnonymousSurvey(input: { props: SurveyProps; host: string; apiKey: string; fetchImpl?: typeof fetch; newId?: () => string }): Promise<void>
  export type SurveyMemory = { seen: Readonly<Partial<Record<SurveyKey, 'shown' | 'answered' | 'dismissed'>>>; eligible: readonly SurveyKey[] }
  export const SURVEY_MEMORY_NAME = 'surveys'   // P2-T3's account store
  export function surveyDue(input: { memory: SurveyMemory; loggedDays: number; ids: SurveyIds; shownThisLaunch: boolean }): SurveyKey | null
  export function markEligible(memory: SurveyMemory, key: SurveyKey): SurveyMemory
  export function useLeavingSurvey(): { slot: ReactNode; onAccepted(): void } | undefined   // undefined unless yes with ids; the choice lives in the route, so the send outlives the form
  ```
- The survey rule: without consent nothing passes; with consent an event passes only with a configured `$survey_id`, its `$survey_questions` replaced by that survey's own; a `$survey_response_<question>` outside the choices drops the event; other `$survey_*` properties go; 1D-T1's removals still apply.
- `sendAnonymousSurvey` posts once to `${host}/i/v0/e/` (PostHog's capture API, through 1D-T2's proxy) `{ api_key, event: 'survey sent', distinct_id: newId(), properties: { ...props, $process_person_profile: false } }`, `newId` being expo-crypto's `randomUUID`; failures are swallowed.
- Triggers (X4): `pmf` once `streakCount(days, today)` (P2-T4) reaches 7; `slip_accuracy` after `markEligible` on a `slip_review_confirmed` heard through `subscribeAppEvents`; one per launch; never again once shown. `SurveyHost` decides once a launch, when Home (`/spend`) first shows in `yes`, with ids and no setup step, and opens a due survey through `useAddTray().whenClosed(...)` (R69); one made due later (a save on the seventh logged day) waits for the next launch, and one still waiting when the tray closes on a save (`record_saved` heard through `subscribeAppEvents`) is dropped for the launch, as that save may open P2-T30's `OverBudgetMoment` the same way. It sends `survey shown`, then `survey sent` (the choice key) or `survey dismissed`. `SurveyTray`: the question, 44 pt radios, ส่งคำตอบ (disabled until a choice), ไม่ตอบ, then a polite `survey.thanks`. `useLeavingSurvey` draws the leaving question in `DeleteScreen`'s slot; its `onAccepted`, run by `useDeleteFlow` once the request is confirmed accepted, sends the chosen key once through `sendAnonymousSurvey`; no shown or dismissed event.
- Copy (drafts, default pending owner Q9; the bracketed key is what PostHog receives): `survey.pmfQuestion` ถ้าวันหนึ่งใช้ Jotbun ไม่ได้แล้ว คุณจะรู้สึกอย่างไร: ผิดหวังมาก (`very_disappointed`), ผิดหวังนิดหน่อย (`somewhat_disappointed`), ไม่ผิดหวัง (`not_disappointed`); `survey.slipQuestion` บันอ่านสลิปให้ถูกแค่ไหน: ถูกทุกใบ (`all_right`), ถูกเกือบทั้งหมด (`mostly_right`), ผิดหลายใบ (`many_wrong`); `survey.leavingQuestion` ถ้าไม่ว่าอะไร ช่วยบอกหน่อยว่าทำไมถึงลบบัญชี: ไม่ได้ใช้แล้ว (`not_needed`), จดแล้วเหนื่อยเกินไป (`too_much_effort`), กังวลเรื่องความเป็นส่วนตัว (`privacy`), ใช้แอปอื่นแทน (`other_app`), เหตุผลอื่น (`other`); `survey.send` ส่งคำตอบ, `survey.skip` ไม่ตอบ, `survey.thanks` ขอบคุณที่ช่วยบอก.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests.** `surveys.test.ts`: `survey ids are parsed strictly`; `surveyProps carries the id, its own question and a listed choice only`. `gate.test.ts`: `before yes no survey event leaves`; `an answer that is not one of the choices drops the event` (`'ค่าเช่าเดือนตุลา ฿4,500'`); `an unknown survey id is dropped`. `neverSent.test.ts`: a `survey sent` holding every sentinel. `controller.test.ts`: `survey events are captured only in yes and never held`. `surveyTriggers.test.ts`: `pmf is due from seven logged days`; `a confirmed slip review makes slip_accuracy due`; `one survey a launch, each once per account, none without ids, never ask_bun or leaving`. `Survey.render.test.tsx`: `after yes the due survey opens on Home and sends survey sent with the choice key, or survey dismissed`; `no survey shows for a person who said no, never answered or signed out, or while a tray is open` (Review Focus 1: `recordAnalytics({ consent: 'no' })`, `{ consent: 'unasked' }` and `setAccount(null)`); `a save that reaches the seventh logged day opens no survey until the next launch`; `the survey opens only after the add tray's onClosed, and none that launch when the tray closes on a save, so the over-budget moment shows alone` (an expense over its category's limit: one `Tray` open); `the chosen leaving answer is sent once when the deletion is accepted, after the receipt replaces the form; a refused or unconfirmed request sends nothing, nor does a person who said no` (through `app/settings/delete.tsx`; the body's `distinct_id` is a UUID that is not the analytics id; `$process_person_profile: false`); `every choice is a 44 pt radio and grows to AX5`.
- [ ] **Step 2: Run them and see them fail.**

- [ ] **Step 4: Run them and see them pass,** then `src/analytics` whole.

Send the leaving answer before acceptance, or under the analytics id: its case fails. Open the survey once `pmf` becomes due: the next-launch case fails. Open a waiting survey after a save: the tray case fails.

  ```ts
  export type JsonValue = null | boolean | number | string | JsonValue[] | { [key: string]: JsonValue }
  export type RemoteFlags = { flags: Record<string, boolean | string>; payloads: Record<string, JsonValue> }
  export function fetchRemoteFlags(input: { host: string; apiKey: string; distinctId: string; fetchImpl?: typeof fetch; timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<RemoteFlags | null>
    // POST `${host}/flags/?v=2` (as @posthog/core 1.60.1) with { api_key, distinct_id } and redirect: 'error', so no redirect takes the phone to PostHog itself;
    // each flag is its variant when it has one, else `enabled`; `metadata.payload` JSON-parsed; null on any failure, timeout (default 5000 ms) or malformed answer
  export const REMOTE_FLAGS_NAME = 'remote-flags'   // P2-T3's account store: the last loaded RemoteFlags, values only
  AnalyticsDeps.flags?: { load(distinctId: string): Promise<RemoteFlags | null>; kept(accountId: string): KeyValueStore }
  PostHogLike.updateFlags(flags: Record<string, boolean | string>, payloads?: Record<string, JsonValue>): void
  PostHogLike.getFeatureFlag(key: string): boolean | string | undefined
  Analytics.flag(key: string): boolean | string | undefined   // undefined unless status() is 'yes' and flags were pushed
  export type RolloutKey = 'bun_ai' | 'slip_import' | 'travel'
  export const ROLLOUT_FLAGS: Readonly<Record<RolloutKey, string>>     // 'rollout-bun-ai', 'rollout-slip-import', 'rollout-travel' (§7: 5%, 25%, everyone)
  export const ROLLOUT_DEFAULTS: Readonly<Record<RolloutKey, boolean>>  // all false (default pending owner Q10)
  export function rolloutOn(key: RolloutKey, value: boolean | string | undefined): boolean   // undefined: the default; true or a variant but 'control': on
  export function useRollout(key: RolloutKey): boolean                  // re-renders when the flags or the consent change
  export type ExperimentKey = 'budget_question' | 'save_celebration' | 'reminder_time'
  export const EXPERIMENTS: Readonly<Record<ExperimentKey, { flag: string; variants: readonly ['control', string] }>>
    // exp-budget-question: no_presets; exp-save-celebration: still; exp-reminder-time: later (default pending owner Q11)
  export function variantOf(key: ExperimentKey, value: boolean | string | undefined): string   // a listed variant, else 'control'
  export function readExperiment(key: ExperimentKey): string   // variantOf over getAnalytics()?.flag; the read is the exposure
  ```
- Rules (X5): entering yes for an account first pushes its kept flags with `client.updateFlags`, so any launch, offline included, shows the last rollouts at once; then, with an analytics id, it loads, pushing and keeping an answer (a failure keeps the old); each `refresh()` in yes loads again; subscribers hear every push. Applying no, entering `unanswered` or signing out erases the kept flags, and 1D-T1's `reset()` empties the client's; `loading` and the launch's account change keep them; a confirmed deletion erases them with the account's other kept data (P2-T3). `flag` reads `client.getFeatureFlag` only in yes, so `$feature_flag_called` is only made after yes; the gate passes `$feature_flag_called` only with consent and removes `$feature_flag_payload` and `$feature_flag_bootstrapped_payload`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests.** `remoteFlags.test.ts` (a fake fetch): `it posts api_key and distinct_id to /flags/?v=2 without following a redirect, and reads flags and variants` (PostHog's documented v2 answer gives `{ 'my-awesome-flag': true, 'my-multivariate-flag': 'some-string-value', 'flag-thats-not-on': false }` and the parsed payload; `redirect` is `'error'`); `a 5xx, a timeout or a malformed answer is null`. `controller.test.ts`: `flags are asked for once yes is entered, with the analytics id, and pushed with updateFlags`; `no flags are asked for unless the answer is yes` (Review Focus 1: signed out, unanswered and no never call `load`); `a launch shows the kept rollouts before the network answers`; `an offline launch in yes keeps the last loaded rollouts`; `a no, an unanswered question or a sign-out clears the kept flags`; `a no from another phone empties the flags at the next foreground`; `flag reads nothing before yes`. `gate.test.ts`: `$feature_flag_called passes only after yes, without payloads` (Review Focus 2). `rollout.test.ts`: `undefined reads the default; true or a variant reads on; false or control reads off`; `an unknown experiment variant reads control`. `useRollout.render.test.tsx`: `useRollout follows the flags once they load after yes, and the default after a no`.
- [ ] **Step 2: Run them and see them fail.**
- [ ] **Step 3: Implement.**
- [ ] **Step 4: Run them and see them pass,** then `npm run test:unit -w gogospend-app -- src/analytics` whole.
- [ ] **Step 5: Mutation check.** Load flags while unanswered: the yes-only case fails. Let `$feature_flag_called` through before yes: the gate case fails. Read `'control'` as on: the rollout case fails. Keep the flags after a no: the clear case fails. Push nothing until the load answers, or erase the flags on `loading`: the launch and offline cases fail.
- [ ] **Step 6: Gate, receipt, commit.** Real flags are SKIPPED until the owner creates them. `git commit -m "Fetch remote flags only after yes and push them into PostHog, with rollouts and experiments that default safely"`

text:
**Starts after:** P6C-T1, P6A-T1 (P6A:native-ids)
**Delivers:** P6C:association-files

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/edge/src/web/association.ts` (pure), `apps/edge/src/server/web.ts` (glue: `env` from `cloudflare:workers`, as 1C's `src/server/auth.ts`)
- Modify: `apps/edge/src/server.ts` (`const web = handleWeb(request); if (web) return web`, after 1D-T2's proxy and 1C's `/api/auth/*`), `wrangler.jsonc` (top-level vars `APPLE_TEAM_ID`, `ANDROID_PACKAGE`, `ANDROID_CERT_SHA256`, `PASSKEY_ORIGINS` `""` and `PASSKEY_RP_ID` `"localhost"`, as 1C-T1's default; both blocks from identity), `scripts/release/identity.mjs` (`passkeyOrigins`), `test/c1-worker.db.test.ts`, `test/release/environments.test.ts`
- Test: `apps/edge/test/association.test.ts` (Node)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `readIdentity`, `hostFor` (P6C-T1); 1C-T1's `APPLE_BUNDLE_ID`, `PASSKEY_RP_ID`, `PASSKEY_ORIGINS`; P6A-T1's `IOS_BUNDLE_ID_PATTERN` and `ANDROID_PACKAGE_PATTERN` (A36), imported from `apps/app/src/wallet/outside/outsideIds.ts`, never copied. P6B's passkey offer reads these files (B22).
- Produces:
  ```ts
  // scripts/release/identity.mjs
  export function passkeyOrigins(identity: Identity, env: 'staging' | 'production'): string   // 'https://' + host, then per android_cert_sha256 'android:apk-key-hash:' + base64url (no padding) of its 32 bytes, joined with ','
  // src/web/association.ts
  export type AssociationSettings = { APPLE_TEAM_ID?: string; APPLE_BUNDLE_ID?: string; ANDROID_PACKAGE?: string; ANDROID_CERT_SHA256?: string }
  export const AASA_PATH = '/.well-known/apple-app-site-association'
  export const ASSETLINKS_PATH = '/.well-known/assetlinks.json'
  export function appleAssociation(s: AssociationSettings): { webcredentials: { apps: string[] } } | null
  export function androidAssociation(s: AssociationSettings): { relation: string[]; target: { namespace: 'android_app'; package_name: string; sha256_cert_fingerprints: string[] } }[] | null
  export function serveAssociation(request: Request, s: AssociationSettings): Response | null   // null: not one of the two paths
  // src/server/web.ts
  export function handleWeb(request: Request): Response | null    // P6C-T3 adds pages
  ```
- Rules (Y10): the team id is `/^[A-Z0-9]{10}$/`, the bundle id and package match P6A-T1's patterns, and `ANDROID_CERT_SHA256` is a comma list of `/^([0-9A-F]{2}:){31}[0-9A-F]{2}$/`; anything missing or malformed makes that file `null`, answered 404 `{ code: 'NOT_FOUND' }`. `GET` and `HEAD` answer 200 with `content-type: application/json` and `cache-control: public, max-age=3600`; other methods 405; exact paths only, never a redirect. Block values: the three ids from identity (fingerprints joined with `,`), `PASSKEY_RP_ID` the host, `PASSKEY_ORIGINS` `passkeyOrigins`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Stub, then write the failing tests.** Stubs return `null`. With `S = { APPLE_TEAM_ID: 'ABCDE12345', APPLE_BUNDLE_ID: 'th.co.jotbun.app', ANDROID_PACKAGE: 'th.co.jotbun.app', ANDROID_CERT_SHA256: `${FP1},${FP2}` }`:
  - `the Apple file names the team and the bundle for passkeys`: `{ webcredentials: { apps: ['ABCDE12345.th.co.jotbun.app'] } }`.
  - `the Android file names the package and every signing fingerprint`: `[{ relation: ['delegate_permission/common.get_login_creds'], target: { namespace: 'android_app', package_name: 'th.co.jotbun.app', sha256_cert_fingerprints: [FP1, FP2] } }]`.
  - `a missing or malformed id serves 404, never a wrong file` (team `ABC`, an empty bundle, the package `th.co.jotbun-app`, fingerprint `zz`; the package `th.co.jotbun_check` is served).
  - `the files are JSON at the exact paths`: both headers; `HEAD` 200; `POST` 405; `/.well-known/apple-app-site-association.json` and `/.well-known/assetlinks` give `null`.
  - `environments.test.ts`: `passkeys and association ids come from release/identity.json, and the top level keeps localhost` (the fingerprint `FA:C6:17:45:DC:09:03:78:6F:B9:ED:E6:2A:96:2B:39:9F:73:48:F0:BB:6F:89:9B:83:32:66:75:91:03:3B:9C` adds the origin `android:apk-key-hash:-sYXRdwJA3hvue3mKpYrOZ9zSPC7b4mbgzJmdZEDO5w`).
  - `c1-worker.db.test.ts`: `the built Worker serves the association files when configured, and 404 when not`.
- [ ] **Step 2: Run them and see them fail.** Run: `npm run test:edge -- test/association.test.ts test/release/environments.test.ts`, then `npm run build:edge && npm run test:edge:db -- test/c1-worker.db.test.ts`. Expected: every case fails against the `null` stubs.
- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** `appleAssociation`, `androidAssociation` and `serveAssociation` in `src/web/association.ts`, `handleWeb` in `src/server/web.ts`, `passkeyOrigins`, the `server.ts` line and the vars.
- [ ] **Step 4: Run them and see them pass,** then the edge gate and `npm run check:envs --prefix apps/edge`.
- [ ] **Step 5: Mutation check.** Serve the Apple file without a team id; accept the `.json` variant; drop the second fingerprint; check the package with the iOS pattern; pad the Android origin: each fails its case.
- [ ] **Step 6: Gate, receipt, commit.** SKIPPED: Apple's and Google's checks on the real domain (D33). `git commit -m "Serve the passkey association files from the Worker, only when every id is real"`

  ```ts
  // src/vault/support.ts
  export type SupportScope = 'health' | 'records'
  export const SUPPORT_RECORD_LIMIT = 200
  export const SUPPORT_TABLES = ['wallets', 'categories', 'transactions', 'monthly_budgets', 'command_receipts', 'entity_changes', 'vault_objects', 'import_uploads'] as const
  export type SupportUnavailable = { unavailable: 'unknown' | 'deleting' | 'deleted' }
  export type SupportSnapshot = {
    scope: SupportScope; account: { status: 'active'; not_before: number }
    revision: string; pruned_through: string; database_bytes: number
    counts: Record<(typeof SUPPORT_TABLES)[number], number>
    schedule: { job: string; due_at: number }[]
    records?: { wallets: unknown[]; categories: unknown[]; transactions: unknown[] }   // 'records' only
  }
  export function readSupportSnapshot(sql: SqlStorage, accountId: string, scope: SupportScope, databaseBytes: number): SupportSnapshot | SupportUnavailable
  // UserVault (RPC)
  supportSnapshot(accountId: string, scope: SupportScope): SupportSnapshot | SupportUnavailable
  ```
- Rules: never through `call()` or `afterCall`, never `ensureAccount`, no `transactionSync`, only `SELECT`s. `deleted` and `deleting` are read before the account id is compared, so an erased vault (empty `account_id`) is `deleted` (C17); then no `account_state` row, or another `account_id`, is `unknown`. Revisions and amounts read with `CAST(... AS TEXT)`; `records` holds every wallet and category and the newest 200 transactions by `(occurred_on, id)` descending, deleted ones with their `deleted_at`; `database_bytes` is `ctx.storage.sql.databaseSize`.

  - `a never-used vault is unknown, and nothing is created`: no `account_state` row and `getAlarm()` null after the call.

  ```ts
  export function storagePitr(ctx: DurableObjectStateLike): PitrPort   // ctx.storage's getCurrentBookmark, getBookmarkForTime, onNextSessionRestoreBookmark; ctx.abort (Durable Objects docs, "PITR")
  export const RESTORE_WINDOW_MS = 29 * 86_400_000, RESTORE_MIN_AGE_MS = 60_000
  export const RESTORE_MARKER_KEY = 'restore-marker'   // in ctx.storage.kv, which a restore brings back with the SQL data
  export type RestoreRefused = { outcome: 'refused'; reason: 'unknown' | 'deleting' | 'deleted' | 'out_of_window' | 'high_water_moved' | 'not_restored' }
  export type RestoreMark = { outcome: 'marked'; high_water: string; not_before: number; revoked: string[]; undo_bookmark: string; created_at: number }   // Date.parse of account_state.created_at (ISO text)
  export type RestoreSettled = { outcome: 'settled'; revision: string }
  // UserVault (RPC); its pitr field defaults to storagePitr(ctx), replaced by tests in runInDurableObject
  restoreHighWater(accountId: string): Promise<RestoreMark | RestoreRefused>                     // reads only
  placeRestoreMarker(accountId: string, highWater: string, grantId: string): Promise<{ outcome: 'placed' } | RestoreRefused>
  prepareRestore(accountId: string, atMs: number, highWater: string): Promise<RestoreRefused>   // otherwise arms the bookmark and aborts in this call
  settleRestore(accountId: string, mark: { high_water: string; not_before: number; revoked: string[] }, grantId: string): RestoreSettled | RestoreRefused
  // src/breakglass/restore-run.ts
  export type RestoreVault = { [K in 'restoreHighWater' | 'placeRestoreMarker' | 'prepareRestore' | 'settleRestore']: (...a: Parameters<UserVault[K]>) => Promise<Awaited<ReturnType<UserVault[K]>>> }
  export function runRestore(env: BreakGlassEnv, grant: RestoreGrant, vault: RestoreVault, nowMs: number): Promise<'restored' | 'refused' | 'running'>   // RestoreGrant: the row's grant_id, user_id, restore_at, started_at, armed_at, settled_at, high_water, session_state
  ```
- `restoreHighWater` refuses an absent, other-owner (`unknown`), `deleting` or `deleted` account; else it returns the revision as text, `not_before`, the unexpired `revoked_sessions` ids, `currentBookmark()` (the undo point) and `account_state.created_at`. `placeRestoreMarker` refuses the same and, as `high_water_moved`, a revision above `highWater`; else it puts `grantId` under `RESTORE_MARKER_KEY` and resolves. `prepareRestore` refuses the same, an `atMs` outside `[now - RESTORE_WINDOW_MS, now - RESTORE_MIN_AGE_MS]` and, as `high_water_moved`, a revision above `highWater`, arming nothing; else `bookmarkForTime(atMs)`, `restoreOnNextSession(bookmark)` and `abort('point-in-time restore')` in one call. `settleRestore` refuses a non-active account and, as `not_restored`, a marker still holding `grantId` (nothing was restored); else, in one `transactionSync`, sets `revision` and `pruned_through` to `max(revision, high_water) + 1` (BigInt, bound as text) (Y14) and re-applies `not_before` (`raiseNotBefore`) and the revoked ids (`revokeSessionIds`).
- `runRestore` records each finished stage on the grant, and a resumed run skips it: (1) with `settled_at` set, only (6)'s release and batch; (2) not yet started: a `restore_at` before the user's `createdAt` (AUTH_DB) or outside the window is `restore_refused` before any hold; then `started_at`, written only while no other restore grant of the subject has started and is still approved (else `restore_refused`, before any hold), then `holdAccount` (false: `restore_refused`; a resumed run takes the hold again); (3) no `high_water`: `restoreHighWater`; a `restore_at` before its `created_at` plus `RESTORE_MIN_AGE_MS` (bookmarks are approximate) is `restore_refused`; else `high_water`, `session_state` (`{ not_before, revoked }`) and the first `undo_bookmark` go on the grant; (4) no `armed_at`: `placeRestoreMarker` with the stored mark (on `high_water_moved`, the one re-read: nothing was armed yet, so the mark is read and stored again and the marker placed; a second is `restore_refused`), then `armed_at`, then `prepareRestore`, whose rejection is expected (the abort); (5) `settleRestore` with the stored mark; on `not_restored`, `prepareRestore` and `settleRestore` once more, and if still `not_restored` the grant stays running and the route answers 503 with a retry; once `armed_at` is set, any refusal from `prepareRestore`, `high_water_moved` included, is `restore_refused`, never a re-read; (6) `settled_at`, then `releaseHold`, then one `BREAKGLASS_DB.batch`: grant `used` (`user_id`, `session_state` cleared) and event `restored` unless the grant has one. The mark and `armed_at` are written only while `armed_at` is null, and `started_at` and `settled_at` only while each is null: when D1 changes no row because that column is set, another run of the grant is ahead, so this one stops and answers 503 with a retry. A refusal releases the hold only once this run took it, closes the grant (clearing `user_id` and `session_state`) and writes `restore_refused`; no other event is written. `POST /grants` also takes `{ email, kind: 'restore', restore_at: <ISO>, reason }`; `POST /grants/:id/restore` (its requester or an approver) runs an approved grant, unexpired or already started.

- [ ] **Step 1: Stub, then write the failing tests.** Stubs answer `refused` `unknown`, `runRestore` `'refused'`. With a fake `PitrPort` answering `undo-1`, `bm-1` and `undo-2`, recording each call, whose `abort` deletes the marker as the restore would and throws, as `ctx.abort` ends the call:
  - `a restore is refused for a deleting, deleted, erased or unknown account, and nothing is created`.
  - `a restore point older than 29 days, newer than one minute or before the account existed is refused before anything is armed` (the window and the user's `createdAt` before any hold; a point before the vault's `created_at` after the mark, the hold released, no marker).
  - `the high-water read changes nothing and reports the mark, the sessions, the undo point and the vault's creation`.
  - `prepare asks for the bookmark at the restore point and restarts in the same call` (`bookmarkForTime(atMs)`, `restoreOnNextSession('bm-1')`, then `abort`).
  - `a write that lands after the high-water read is caught before anything is armed` (`high_water_moved` from `placeRestoreMarker` and from `prepareRestore`; no marker; the port records nothing).
  - `settling before the restore is refused` (`not_restored` while this grant's marker is there, nothing changed; another grant's marker does not count).
  - `after a restore every older cursor is 410, and no revision is used twice`: at revision R, mark, marker, prepare, `evictAllDurableObjects`, settle with `String(R + 5n)`: revision and `pruned_through` are `R + 6`; a cursor at R gets 410 `RESYNC_REQUIRED`; the next write commits `R + 7`.
  - `a session signed out before the restore stays signed out after it`.
  - `the tool restores in order and releases the hold` (a fake `RestoreVault`: hold, mark, marker, `armed_at`, prepare, settle, `settled_at`, release; no `account_status` row after; one `restored` event).
  - `a prepare that fails before arming is never settled, and the grant stays running` (prepare rejects with a network error and settle answers `not_restored` twice: 503 with a retry, the hold kept, `settled_at` null, no event).
  - `a run that died before arming settles above the original high water`.
  - `a resumed run that has armed never reads the high water again` (the vault now below the stored mark: no `restoreHighWater` call; settle gets the stored mark; with `armed_at` set, settle comes before any prepare, and `high_water_moved` from prepare is `restore_refused`).
  - `a run that stopped after settling only releases the hold when resumed` (`settled_at` set, the hold on: `releaseHold`, `used` and one `restored` event; no vault call).
  - `a run that stopped after releasing the hold never restores again` (`settled_at` set, no hold, the vault above the mark: no vault call, no hold taken, `used` and one `restored` event).
  - `a restore grant past its 30 minutes keeps its subject while the account is held, and resuming it finishes and releases the hold` (meanwhile `?status=running` lists it).
  - `two runs of one grant arm it, settle it and record restored once` (two resumed runs at once over one fake `RestoreVault`: at most two `prepareRestore`s, to the same point while held, one `settled_at`, one `restored` event; the other answers 503 with a retry).
  - `a restore grant is refused while another of the subject runs, and that hold stays` (another started, approved restore grant: `restore_refused` before any hold, the `held` row kept, no vault call).
- [ ] **Step 2: Run them and see them fail.** Run: `npm run test:edge:workers -- test/workers/restore.test.ts`. Expected: every case fails against the stubs, except the refusal case (a guard).
- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** `storagePitr` and the four RPCs (`src/vault/restore.ts`, `user-vault.ts`), `runRestore` in `src/breakglass/restore-run.ts`, and the restore body and route in `handler.ts`.
- [ ] **Step 4: Run them and see them pass,** then 1C's auth-vault and deletion suites unchanged, the break-glass suite, and the edge gate.
- [ ] **Step 5: Mutation check.** Settle without `pruned_through`; settle with the marker still there; prepare before settling on a resumed run; read the high water again on resume; write `armed_at` without its null check; let the sweep expire a started restore grant: each fails its case.
- [ ] **Step 6: Docs.** `restore.md`: when (default pending owner Q14); the restore grant; what the person loses; receipts deleted after the point stay missing and later uploads stay under the prefix until deletion (R2 has no history); a stuck hold, found through `GET /grants?status=running` or `SELECT user_id FROM account_status WHERE status = 'held'` (`npx wrangler d1 execute`), released by resuming its grant, and by hand only when the grant is gone (never while it has `armed_at` without `settled_at`); undoing a mistaken restore (a new restore grant to the first one's `started_at`; its `undo_bookmark` names the exact point); D1 by `npx wrangler d1 time-travel restore <db> --timestamp <RFC3339> --env <env> -c wrangler.jsonc`, deleting every `session` row after restoring `AUTH_DB` so revived sessions mint nothing; never `ERASURE_DB` or `BREAKGLASS_DB` backwards; `CATALOG_DB` freely; `config:v1` re-seeded.
- [ ] **Step 7: Gate, receipt, commit.** SKIPPED: a real restore on staging (Q1). `git commit -m "Restore one vault by point-in-time recovery, holding the account and moving every phone to a resync"`

title: The owner's setup: PostHog, the dashboards, spend alerts, AI Gateway and retention
heading: Task P6C-T11: The owner's setup: PostHog, the dashboards, spend alerts, AI Gateway and retention
starts_after_text: 1D-T1, 1D-T3; Step 6 also waits on P6B-T13 and P6B-T14.
text:
**Starts after:** 1D-T1, 1D-T3; Step 6 also waits on P6B-T13 and P6B-T14.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/app/src/analytics/dashboards.ts` (pure, no imports: the script loads it by type stripping), `apps/app/scripts/posthog-dashboards.mjs`, `docs/operations/owner-setup.md`
- Modify: `apps/app/package.json` (`"posthog:dashboards": "node scripts/posthog-dashboards.mjs"`), `docs/operations/retention.md`, `incident.md` (rewritten)
- Delete: `docs/operations/e1-setup.md` (replaced by `owner-setup.md`)
- Test: `apps/app/src/analytics/dashboards.test.ts` (Node)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `APP_EVENTS: Readonly<Record<AppEventName, Readonly<Record<string, PropRule>>>>` (1D-T1); 1D-T3's server events and its common `origin` (`app` or `server`); PostHog's `$ai_total_cost_usd` on `$ai_generation`; PostHog's REST API on `https://eu.posthog.com` with `Authorization: Bearer <personal API key>`: `POST /api/projects/:project_id/dashboards/` `{ name, description, tags }` (`dashboard:write`), `POST /api/projects/:project_id/insights/` `{ name, query, dashboards }` (`insight:write`); P6B-T13's `SurveyIds` and `SURVEYS` choices, P6B-T14's `ROLLOUT_FLAGS` and `EXPERIMENTS`.
- Produces:
  ```ts
  // src/analytics/dashboards.ts
  export type InsightSpec = { name: string; kind: 'trends' | 'funnel' | 'retention' | 'stickiness' | 'hogql'; events: readonly string[]; breakdown?: string; windowDays?: number; hogql?: string }
  export type DashboardSpec = { name: string; insights: readonly InsightSpec[]; alert: { insight: string; decreasesByPercent: number } }
  export const SERVER_EVENT_NAMES = ['record_saved', 'sync_failed', 'resync_required', 'account_deleted'] as const
  export const POSTHOG_EVENT_NAMES = ['$exception', '$ai_generation', '$screen'] as const
  export const NORTH_STAR_HOGQL: string
  export const DASHBOARDS: readonly DashboardSpec[]
  // scripts/posthog-dashboards.mjs: CLI `[--apply]`, with POSTHOG_DASHBOARD_API_KEY (only dashboard:write and insight:write; never the Worker's POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY) and POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID
  export function dashboardBody(spec)                       // { name, description: '§7 dashboard', tags: ['jotbun'] }
  export function trendsInsightBody(insight, dashboardId)   // { name, query: { kind: 'InsightVizNode', source: { kind: 'TrendsQuery', interval: 'week', series: [{ kind: 'EventsNode', event, math: 'total' }, ...] } }, dashboards: [dashboardId] }
  ```
- `DASHBOARDS` (Y15), each insight named for what §7 shows: **Activation** (funnel `Activation funnel`: `signed_up`, `budget_set`, `record_saved`; funnel `First record within a day`: `signed_up`, `record_saved`, `windowDays` 1); **Habit** (retention `Retention` and stickiness `Stickiness` on `record_saved`; hogql `Logging days per week`, the north star); **Capture mix** (trends `Records by source`: `record_saved` by `source`; hogql `Seconds to save`: the median `seconds_to_save` of the app's `record_saved` this week); **Bun AI quality** (trends `LLM analytics`: `$ai_generation`, `ai_draft_reviewed` by `outcome`; hogql `Cost per kept record`: the week's `$ai_total_cost_usd` over its `ai_draft_reviewed` with outcome `kept`); **Slip import** (funnel `Slip import funnel`: `albums_connected`, `slip_scan_finished`, `slip_review_confirmed`); **Travel** (trends `Travel trends`: `home_currency_set`, `trip_started`, `rate_overridden`, `cash_exchanged`); **Reliability** (hogql `Crash-free sessions`: the share of the week's app sessions with no `$exception`; trends `Sync failures` (`sync_failed`, `resync_required`), `Conflicts` (`conflict_shown`), `AI down` (`ai_unavailable`)); **Recap and bridge** (trends `Recaps opened and shared`: `recap_opened`, `recap_shared`; `Cashback card taps`: `cashback_card_tapped`). Each alert: a 30% week-on-week decrease.
- `NORTH_STAR_HOGQL` (Y17, default pending owner Q13), with `B = toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Bangkok'))`: `SELECT avg(days) FROM (SELECT person_id, count(DISTINCT if(event IN ('record_saved', 'slip_review_confirmed'), toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok')), NULL)) AS days FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 8 DAY AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok')) >= subtractDays(B, 7) AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok')) < B GROUP BY person_id HAVING countIf(properties.origin = 'app' AND event NOT IN ('$exception', 'account_deleted')) > 0)`, `B` written out in full.
- The script prints every request; with `--apply` it posts each dashboard, reads its `id`, posts its trends insights, then prints the manual list (funnels, retention, stickiness, every hogql insight, breakdowns, alerts).

- [ ] **Step 1: Stub, then write the failing tests.** Stubs: `DASHBOARDS = []`, bodies `{}`.
  - `there are exactly §7's eight dashboards, each with a drop alert on one of its insights`.
  - `each of §7's Shows items has an insight`: the fixture copies §7's "Shows" column item by item (with Activation's "first record within a day") as dashboard and insight-name pairs, and each pair is in `DASHBOARDS`.
  - `every event is one Jotbun sends or PostHog makes` (a key of `APP_EVENTS`, or in either name list).
  - `every breakdown is a property its event allows` (`source` in `APP_EVENTS.record_saved`, `outcome` in `APP_EVENTS.ai_draft_reviewed`).
  - `the north star counts 7 complete Bangkok days with a record or a confirmed slip, for consenting people only`: `toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok')`; no `toDate(timestamp,` or `toDate(now(),`; both day bounds; both events; the `origin = 'app'` filter in `HAVING`.
  - `a trends insight is the documented query`: `trendsInsightBody({ name: 'Travel trends', kind: 'trends', events: ['trip_started'] }, 7)` deep-equals the shape above.
- [ ] **Step 2: Run them and see them fail.** Run: `npm run test:unit -w gogospend-app -- src/analytics/dashboards.test.ts`. Expected: every case fails against the stubs, except the two vacuous guards (`every event …`, `every breakdown …`).
- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** `DASHBOARDS`, `NORTH_STAR_HOGQL` and the name lists in `dashboards.ts`, and `dashboardBody`, `trendsInsightBody` and the CLI in `posthog-dashboards.mjs`.
- [ ] **Step 4: Run them and see them pass,** then the app gate.
- [ ] **Step 5: Mutation check.** Add an event outside the allow-list; drop the Bangkok time zone; count today; drop the `origin` filter: each fails its case.
- [ ] **Step 6: Docs.** `owner-setup.md`, in order, each with who, where and its SKIPPED status: D33 and `release/identity.json`; provisioning (P6C-T6); secrets; the Email Service domain; the Access application; **AI Gateway** per environment (`jotbun-staging`, `jotbun-production`; logs and caching off, no rate limit (B27), authentication per P3's gateway question) and `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`; **spend alerts (B27)**: Cloudflare billing notifications and Anthropic's console limit and alerts (default pending owner Q6); **PostHog EU**: the project with 1D's settings, the keys (`POSTHOG_DASHBOARD_API_KEY` with the two write scopes only), the batch export to `jotbun-analytics-copy` (`https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`, a token for that bucket, JSON lines, 90 days, default pending owner Q7), `npm run posthog:dashboards -w gogospend-app -- --apply` then the manual list, and a check that `$ai_generation` for `claude-haiku-5-5` and `claude-opus-5-5` gets `$ai_total_cost_usd` (else P3-T10's allow-list gains PostHog's custom price properties, P3 H8); P6B-T13's `pmf`, `slip_accuracy` and `leaving` as single-choice API surveys with its choice keys, their survey and question UUIDs into identity's `posthog_survey_ids` and `eas.json`; P6B-T14's flags by their exact keys (`ROLLOUT_FLAGS`, and each `EXPERIMENTS` flag with `control` and its variant); EAS and the stores. `retention.md`: what is kept where and how long (soft deletes and changes 30 days; R2 prefixes 1 day, receipts until deleted; `ERASURE_DB` 60 days; the break-glass audit 365 days by keyed hash, kept after a deletion (counsel, G1); the analytics copy 90 days; Workers Logs without query strings; AI Gateway logs off). `incident.md`: pausing through `config:v1` gates (`kv key get`, edit, `kv key put`), Workers Logs by `failureName`, a support code (P6B-T9: the first eight hex digits of a problem's `request_id`, in Workers Logs only on the Worker's 500 line with `route` and the error class; else the time and screen), PostHog errors, AI Gateway 429s (B27), `rollback.md`, `breakglass.md`, telling people (C9).
- [ ] **Step 7: Gate, receipt, commit.** SKIPPED: every console step and `--apply` (Q1). `git commit -m "Add the owner's setup checklist, the eight dashboards as a tested module, and the retention and incident runbooks"`

text:
**Starts after:** P6C-T3, P6C-T5, P6C-T12

**Files:**

- Modify: `apps/app/eas.json` (both store links)
- Test: `apps/app/src/release/storeListing.test.ts` (Node)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `release/identity.json`; `PAGE_PATHS` (P6C-T3); the review sign-in (P6C-T5); `docs/design/bun-wallet/*.dc.html`.
- Produces (P6B's store link reads the two URLs):
  - `listing.json`: `{ status: 'draft', apple: { name, subtitle, promotional_text, description, keywords, support_url, privacy_url }, google: { title, short_description, full_description }, review: { notes }, screenshots: [{ board, locale, theme }] }`, every text `{ th, en }`, the URLs the production host's `/support` and `/privacy`.
  - `privacy.json`: `{ status: 'draft', tracking: false, processors: [{ name, purpose, region? }], apple_labels: [{ data, purposes, linked }], play_data_safety: { collected: [{ data, purposes, optional }], shared: [], encrypted_in_transit: true, deletion: { in_app: true, url } }, encryption: { uses_encryption: true, answer: 'pending counsel', notes } }`; processors `Cloudflare` (hosting, storage), `PostHog` (`EU`; analytics after consent, crash reports), `Anthropic` (Bun AI once turned on), `Expo` (push delivery), `Resend` (email, only if turned on). Draft answers (default pending owner Q4): Apple `Email Address` (App Functionality, linked); `Other Financial Info`, `Other User Content` and `Photos or Videos` (records, notes, receipt photos: App Functionality, linked); `User ID` and `Product Interaction` (Analytics, linked, after consent); `Crash Data` (App Functionality, not linked, sent without consent while the switch is on). Play `Email address` (App functionality, Account management); `Other financial info`, `Other user-generated content` and `Photos` (App functionality); `User IDs` and `App interactions` (Analytics, optional); `Crash logs` and `Diagnostics` (App functionality); nothing shared, nobody tracked.
  - `eas.json` production: `EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_STORE_URL` `https://apps.apple.com/app/id<app_store_id>`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_PLAY_STORE_URL` `https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=<android_package>`, each `""` while its id is a placeholder or `confirmed_by_owner` is false.
- Copy (drafts, default pending owner Q5): name `Jotbun`; subtitle `บันจดเงิน สมุดจดเงินส่วนตัว` / `A private money diary`; the description from the trust page's six promises and §5.2's flows; review notes say sign-in is by email code and that the owner enters the review address and code in each console's review fields, never in this file.

- [ ] **Step 1: Stub, then write the failing tests.** Stubs: both files `{ "status": "draft" }`.
  - `listing text fits each store's limits, in both languages`: App Store name and subtitle 30 characters, promotional text 170, keywords 100, description 4000; Play title 30, short description 80, full description 4000.
  - `listing text is Thai and English, with no emojis or dashes`.
  - `the listing never says Jotbun cannot read records, never shows a cashback amount, never says AI saves for you`: no match for `/cannot read|ไม่สามารถอ่าน|end-to-end/i`, `/(เงินคืน|แคชแบ็ก|cashback)[^.]*฿|฿[^.]*(เงินคืน|แคชแบ็ก|cashback)/i` or `/AI บันทึกให้/`.
  - `support, privacy and deletion URLs are the production pages`.
  - `the privacy answers name Cloudflare, PostHog in the EU, Anthropic, Expo and Resend, track nobody, and give the deletion page`.
  - `the draft privacy answers declare each data type with its purpose` (each Apple and Play entry above, deep-equal).
  - `nobody declares the app free of encryption`.
  - `the store links are built from the store ids, and empty until the owner confirms`.
  - `every screenshot names an existing board`, and `review notes hold no six-digit number`.
- [ ] **Step 2: Run them and see them fail.** Run: `npm run test:unit -w gogospend-app -- src/release/storeListing.test.ts`. Expected: every case fails against the stubs, except the anti-goal case (a guard).
- [ ] **Step 3: Write the records** and the two `eas.json` values.
- [ ] **Step 4: Run them and see them pass,** then the app gate.
- [ ] **Step 5: Mutation check.** Add `Jotbun cannot read your records`; drop Expo from the processors: each fails its case.
- [ ] **Step 6: Receipt, commit.** SKIPPED: the App Store Connect and Play Console records, screenshots, age rating, reviewer fields (Q1, Q5). `git commit -m "Add the store records: listing text, privacy and Data safety answers, review access notes and the store links"`

  ```js
  // scripts/ops/beta-gate.mjs: CLI prints each problem; exit 0 only when none
  export const PLAN_IDS = { p1a: '1A', p1b: '1B', p1c: '1C', p1d: '1D', p2: 'P2', p3: 'P3', p4: 'P4', p5: 'P5', p6a: 'P6A', p6b: 'P6B', p6c: 'P6C' }

  export function parseGate(markdown)    // { rows: { id, item, status, evidence }[], questions: { key, answer }[] }
  export function gateProblems(markdown, plans) // plans { file, text }[]: a row not PASS or without evidence; a question unanswered ('decided <date>: …' or 'default accepted <date>'); a '<plan> Q<n>' missing
  ```
- Gate rows: **G1** counsel signs off every Q4 item (Q4, Q7, §6.11); **G2** the Anthropic retention decision and zero retention (§6.7); **G3** the break-glass tool live behind Access with one view, one restore and one staff deletion rehearsed on test accounts in its audit (P6C-T9, T9b, T10b); **G4** Apple token revocation proven on a device (1C-T13); **G5** every receipt PASS: each SKIPPED hosted or device check in the receipts of 1A to P6C is PASS or waived in writing; **G6** every E2 checkpoint of every plan approved (the owner's screenshots); **G7** D33 done, `confirmed_by_owner` true, `release:preflight production` passing; **G8** the C9 address reaching a person; **G9** staging and production deployed, `release:smoke` passing on both; **G10** spend alerts (B27), AI Gateway, the PostHog project, priced AI generations, dashboards, alerts and batch export; **G11** a TestFlight build and a Play closed-track release with symbols uploaded, listings and review access in place; **G12** every owner question answered or its default accepted; **G13** each release switch set as the owner decided, staging first (P6C-T14b).
- The question table holds every question of every plan. Decided ones carry their decision and date (1B's Q1 to Q4; 1C's Q1, Q3, Q4, Q5, Q7; 1D's Q1 to Q18, decided 2026-10-25, the owner actions behind its Q4 to Q9 staying under G1, G6, G10 and G11). One more row covers the controller's calls B1 to B27 and the plans' own calls, which the owner may overturn.
